rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Now the rook has a bishop and a knight. The bishop takes squares from afar; the knight, up close.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: Count the black king's squares: the bishop on h6 attacks g7, and the knight on g5 attacks h7.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: Only the last rank is left to close, with a rook check.
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: Checkmate! The rook closes the last rank; the bishop guards g7, and the knight, h7.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook goes to a8 and checks along the edge. Every escape square is taken.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a7.1: The rook on the seventh traps the king, but gives no check, and g8 is free.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a7.2: The black king goes to g8.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a7.3: Let's go back: the right check is along the last rank.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move does not give mate. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: Remember: the bishop and the knight take the escapes, and the rook closes the edge.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: The rook on the seventh traps the black king on the last rank. The e6 knight takes f8.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: The king walks between g8 and h8. Take the bishop to the diagonal through h7; then the rook mates.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Prepare the mate with the bishop, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! From d3, the bishop guards h7. The black king only has h8.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The bishop goes to d3 and guards h7. The black king is left with only h8.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a7a8.1: It is check, but the rook left the seventh and freed the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a7a8.2: The black king escapes to f7.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a7a8.3: Let's go back: first the bishop, then the rook.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move does not prepare the mate. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Prepare the mate with the bishop, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The black king goes to h8, its only square.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Checkmate! The knight guards g7, and the bishop guards h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Now I will show the net built step by step, and a danger: stalemate.
rot.demos.rede.e1: Watch the rook, the bishop and the knight take all the black king's squares, without the white king.
rot.demos.rede.l1: The bishop goes to h6 and takes g7.
rot.demos.rede.l2: The black king goes to h7 and threatens to capture the bishop.
rot.demos.rede.l3: The rook protects the bishop along the sixth rank.
rot.demos.rede.l4: The black king goes back to g8.
rot.demos.rede.l5: The knight jumps to g5 and takes h7 and f7. The bishop already takes f8.
rot.demos.rede.l7: Checkmate! The bishop guards g7, the knight guards h7, and the rook closes the edge.
rot.demos.afogamento.e1: Now a danger. The rook and the bishop guard g7 and h7. Only g8 is left.
rot.demos.afogamento.l1: If the knight went to f6, it would take g8 without check. The king would have no move: stalemate.
rot.demos.afogamento.l2: Instead of f6, the knight goes to g5: it takes h7 and f7, and leaves g8 free.
rot.demos.afogamento.l3: The black king goes to g8.
rot.demos.afogamento.l4: Checkmate! The bishop guards f8 and g7, and the knight guards f7 and h7.
rot.demos.afogamento.l5: Now it's your turn: trap the king with the rook, take squares with bishop and knight, count escapes.
rot.pratica.preparar.enunciado: Prepare the mate: the knight takes c8 and b7. Take the bishop to a square that guards a7; then the rook.
rot.pratica.preparar.fim: Perfect. The bishop took a7, and the rook gave mate.
rot.pratica.preparar.err.h7h8: It is check, but the rook left the seventh, and the king escapes. Try again.
rot.pratica.centro.enunciado: The black king is in the center. Trap it on a rank with the rook and use bishop and knight.
rot.pratica.centro.fim: Well done. You knew how to combine the three pieces.
